jobs.title: Apprentice Electrician
jobs.summary: Assist journeymen with conduit installation, lighting, and power distribution. Must be enrolled in an approved apprenticeship program or willing to enroll.

jobs.title: Journeyman Electrician
jobs.summary: Perform electrical installations, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Valid Kansas electrical license required.

jobs.title: Electrical Foreman
jobs.summary: Lead electrical crews on commercial and industrial projects. Supervise safety, schedule, and quality control.

jobs.title: Electrical Estimator
jobs.summary: Prepare accurate cost estimates for electrical projects including material takeoffs, labor calculations, and project analysis.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Estimator
jobs.summary: Lead estimating for large industrial/commercial projects; deliver accurate, strategic bids and mentor estimators.
